translations./title: After creating the files, write the requested content
translations./summary: In WebDevProjects, the user wants styles.css, index.html and script.js to contain Hello World!, Hi World! and Halo World!, respectively. The user then asks for the second filename in system order and the contents of the first file. In this environment, echo can only write to files that already exist.
translations./presentation/methods/0/description: After a missing-file error, creates the file and retries the write.
translations./presentation/methods/6/description: Swaps the content intended for styles.css and index.html.
translations./presentation/methods/5/description: Creates the missing files, but only completes the write for the last one.
translations./presentation/methods/4/description: Creates index.html without writing its content.
translations./presentation/methods/3/description: Creates index.html and script.js, then rewrites the already completed styles.css instead of writing to the two new files.
translations./presentation/methods/2/description: Writes all three files correctly, but then selects files using an assumed alphabetical order.
translations./presentation/methods/1/description: Creates each file and writes the corresponding content.
translations./presentation/turns/1/summary: The user asks for system order, excluding hidden files.
